task: N1 pure waveform boundary feasibility only; no model, TTS, ASR, KWS, playback delivery, publication or source modification
coordinate_convention: Zero-based sample indices; all intervals half-open [start, end), seconds = index / sample rate; no guessed word or phone labels
exact_zero: Enumerate every maximal contiguous run of samples numerically equal to zero (including signed float zero); list all runs; candidate gap requires duration >= 20 ms

rms.float32_normalization: native stored float value, reference full scale = 1.0
rms.definition: sqrt(sum(x^2) / N), computed using Python float and math.fsum
rms.candidate_gap: maximal consecutive run of at least two full low-RMS windows (at least 20 ms)
rms.final_partial_window: excluded, with its original sample interval reported; no zero padding

constraints: No parameter sweep, forced alignment, peak-based identity inference, transcript-length timing inference, TTS-duration timing inference, or KWS score access
interpretation: Measured intervals are candidate acoustic gaps only. None is a clause separator, phoneme boundary, terminal-窝 interval, or external gold annotation without independent human timing evidence. A confirmed full transcript provides identity/order but no timestamps.
